text:
maria_support: FYI customer reported weird scoring from /v1/rerank/batch when sending multiple queries in one request — 200 OK but scores appear shifted between queries :confused:

maria_support: Example payload the customer sent (redacted):
```json
{
  "requests": [
    {"query_id":"q1","query":"how to reset pwd","candidates": ["c1", "c2"]},
    {"query_id":"q2","query":"billing charges unclear","candidates": ["c3", "c4"]}
  ]
}
```

maria_support: Response they got maps scores cross-queries (q1 got scores for q2 candidates). x-request-id: req_abc123

josh_dev: can you paste the raw request body + full response? also which model + sdk version?

maria_support: pasted snippet below — they used SDK v1.43.0 and model rerank-v2-small:
```json
POST /v1/rerank/batch
Body: { ... }
Response: 200
{
  "results": [
    {"query_id":"q1","scores": [0.12, 0.95]},
    {"query_id":"q2","scores": [0.40, 0.55]}
  ]
}
```
But customer shows q1 texts align with the second scores array.

olivia_eng: is this the multiquery flattening codepath? @josh we changed the per-query candidate delimiter in 1.43.0, might be related. Can you repro locally?

josh_dev: repro script (minimal) — I can reproduce quickly:
```py
payload = {
  "requests": [
    {"query": "A", "candidates": ["a1", "a2"]},
    {"query": "B", "candidates": ["b1"]}
  ]
}
resp = client.rerank_batch(payload)
# observed: resp[0].scores length == 1 but expected 2 -> scores shifted
```

tom_sre: marking P2. Early hypothesis: off-by-one in candidate offset table when empty lists or single-item queries are packed. Also check gzipped chunk boundaries. Example log: `REQ_ID=req_abc123 candidate_offsets=[0,2,3] computed_offsets=[0,1,3]` — that mismatch would cause re-mapping.

olivia_eng: found culprit in serializer: we switched delimiter from '\t' to '\u0000' for the flat buffer but forgot to update the header that carries candidate counts for the new encoding. So decoder sometimes reads wrong count when a candidate contains the delimiter byte. Patch idea: always include explicit `candidate_counts` array in batched request to avoid relying on delimiters.

maria_support: customer needs a workaround ASAP — they do ~10k qps. Can we recommend single-query requests or smaller batches until patch?

josh_dev: deployable interim: if header `X-CANDIDATE-COUNT` is missing, fallback to legacy length-decoding (more conservative). Deployed to staging, running smoke tests now.

maria_support: customer will try single-query batching and confirm. Ticket TKT-1123 updated. :thumbsup:

repro-bot: added flaky test `batch_rerank_multiquery_offsets` to CI and attached reproduction to PR #3456.

tom_sre: follow-up action: add telemetry to log mismatched candidate counts + request IDs for next 24h so we can find any lingering cases in prod. Also escalate if rates > 0.1% errors.

josh_dev: opened PR 3457 with fix + unit tests (covers empty list, single candidate, and delimiter-in-candidate cases). Canary deploying to us-west-2 in 30m :rocket:

maria_support: thanks all — I'll circle back with the customer once canary is healthy. :pray:
